footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to T1 Energy: includes a $19.4M income tax benefit, $367M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests; after $46.5M of discontinued operations.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 256.7× to $755M in 2025. Gross margin was 7.4%, versus 41.7% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $235M from $79.0M.
The net loss narrowed to $381K, or −$2.19 per share, from $451K. Operating cash flow was $95.5M and free cash flow $16.7M, versus −$154M.
sources: T1 Energy Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
